_note: One entry per thing that happened. Newest first. hat is one of: artist, ar, tv, live, community. 'display' overrides the formatted date when the exact day is not known. 'cover' on an artist moment shows the artwork on its card.

moments.title: A full album with Idris Elba
moments.body: Kardi and Idris have been trading records for two years. Vol. 2 carried two of them. The whole project lands in spring.

moments.title: 2 Bad Man, the podcast
moments.body: Kardi's podcast is in production. Name's locked. First episode details land here and on the channel.

moments.title: Firestarter Vol. 2: Everyday, Sometimes…
moments.body: Ten tracks on Black Stone Colleagues, 25 years after Vol. 1. T-Pain, Black Thought, Idris Elba, Buju Banton, Melanie Fiona, Glenn Lewis. Mostly produced by Kardi himself.

moments.title: Kiss Me When I, with Glenn Lewis
moments.body: The last single before the album. Two Toronto voices, one slow burn.

moments.title: I Still Call It Caribana 2026
moments.body: Kardi's own Caribana weekend event in Toronto. The name is the point.

moments.title: Canada Day, Prince's Island Park, Calgary
moments.body: A city singing Dangerous back at him on the country's birthday.

moments.title: My Brother's Keeper, Parts 1 and 2
moments.body: Two singles, one message. Part 2 brings in NESTA.

moments.title: JUNO Awards, Hamilton
moments.body: Red carpet at TD Coliseum with the next generation of Canadian hip-hop.

moments.title: KARDI Christmas Party, year 25
moments.body: The charity party he has thrown every December since 2000. Toys, food and a packed room for the city that made him.

moments.title: SOAK, with Rotimi and Ocean Banks
moments.body: Summer record. DJ pack went out to the selectors the same week.

moments.title: LET EM OUT
moments.body: First single of the Vol. 2 run.

moments.title: Canada's Got Talent, season 5
moments.body: Fourth season at the judges' desk, alongside Howie Mandel, Shania Twain and Katherine Ryan.

moments.title: Icon Award, The Legacy Awards
moments.body: Presented by Jully Black at the Black Academy's Legacy Awards, live on CBC.

moments.title: Joins Def Jam as Global A&R
moments.body: Signing and developing artists worldwide alongside Tunji Balogun and LaTrice Burnette, after nine years leading A&R at Universal Music Canada.

moments.title: First season on Canada's Got Talent
moments.body: Joins the judging panel for the show's return on Citytv.
